bible_verses.english: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
I saw until thrones were placed, and an Ancient of Days sat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool. His throne was fiery flames, and its wheels burning fire.
who alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light; whom no man has seen, nor can see; to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

devotional.prayer_english: Immortal and all-wise Father, I stand in awe of Your unseen glory and endless majesty. Forgive me for the times I try to rush Your timing or measure Your presence by what my eyes can see. Teach my heart to rest in Your silent, faithful work, knowing that You reign victorious over all my days. May my life bring praise to Your great and holy Name today. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we gaze upon the majesty of God, we are reminded that He exists beyond the limits of our human understanding—wrapped in unapproachable light yet deeply present in our lives. He works without haste or weariness, moving silently to accomplish His perfect will. As we sing these truth-filled words, we are invited to bow in awe, letting go of our need to control everything and instead trusting the wisdom of the Ancient of Days. In His glorious, unchanging light, our restless hearts finally find quiet peace.
